The '''2012–13 Bethune–Cookman Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Bethune–Cookman University]] during the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Wildcats, led by second year head coach [[Gravelle Craig]], played their home games at the [[Moore Gymnasium]] and were members of the [[Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 14–20, 7–9 in MEAC play to finish in eighth place. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2013 MEAC men's basketball tournament|MEAC tournament]] where they lost to Morgan State.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.news-journalonline.com/story/news/2013/03/15/bethune-cookman-falls-to-morgan-state-in-meac-semifinals/30616101007/|title=Bethune-Cookman falls to Morgan State in MEAC semifinals|work=[[The Daytona Beach News-Journal]]|date=March 15, 2013|access-date=March 1, 2024}}</ref>
